appearance_facts.location: pie chart, upper-left to upper-center sector
appearance_facts.fact: A pale-yellow wedge occupies the largest angular span, running from the 12 o'clock position counter-clockwise to roughly the 8 o'clock position.

appearance_facts.location: pie chart, left to lower-left sector
appearance_facts.fact: A deep-red wedge spans roughly from the 8 o'clock to the 5 o'clock position, clearly smaller than the yellow wedge.

appearance_facts.location: pie chart, upper-right to right sector
appearance_facts.fact: An orange wedge spans roughly from the 12 o'clock to the 3 o'clock position, the smallest visible sector.

appearance_facts.location: pie chart, lower-right to bottom sector
appearance_facts.fact: A light-orange wedge spans roughly from the 3 o'clock to the 5 o'clock position, intermediate in size.
All four wedges meet at a single central point; sector area is the only size channel.

printed_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
